function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, but I can give you a quick overview of what Boston’s weather usually looks like around this time of year:

| Season | Typical Temperature Range | Common Weather |
|--------|---------------------------|----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 0 °F to 30 °F (−18 °C to −1 °C) | Snow, sleet, cold winds |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | 30 °F to 60 °F (−1 °C to 15 °C) | Variable – rain, occasional warm spells |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | 65 °F to 85 °F (18 °C to 29 °C) | Warm, humid, occasional thunderstorms |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | 45 °F to 70 °F (7 °C to 21 °C) | Mild, crisp, colorful foliage |

If you need the current forecast, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or ask a voice assistant like Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the latest forecast from a specific source!
